vintageNote: Plant locations are the NRCan NACEI file (reference periods 2000–201708, mostly August 2017). That is the latest geospatial plant file NRCan publishes. It is not a current-year capacity census. Remote communities are the 2018 official file: the 2025 service did not answer on this pull. The quarterly job retries 2025 first.
